planets.name: HD 86226 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 86226 with a 3.98-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 86226 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 86226. Its orbit and size follow Teske et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
